analyst_view.overall: Early view: Marseille have won five league games in a row under Bruno Genesio, including 2-1 at Lens, and won 1-0 at Leverkusen in the Europa League; they host Levski Sofia four days after this. Le Mans (15th) are without a win in five league games but drew 1-1 with Monaco last time and outshot them 19-5.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.6 goals. I stay with that: Marseille score 2.2 a game, the best rate in the league, with Amine Gouiri in form, and Le Mans have conceded 19. Le Mans' fight against Monaco suggests they will not fold easily, which stops me going higher.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.1 corners. That looks right: Marseille average 4.5 corners and Le Mans 3.0 (17th), though Marseille should win more than usual against a deep block. Le Mans did win eight against Monaco, so they can add a few.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards. I lean higher: Le Mans are 3rd for fouls (14.8 a game), were described before the Monaco game as a little over-aggressive at the back, and made 16 fouls in that match. Marseille's 55.7% average possession should draw plenty of fouls.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.0 shots. I lean slightly lower: Marseille average 13.2 shots a game and Le Mans 10.7, and Marseille may manage minutes before Levski. Marseille had 16 at Lens, so a big home total is possible but not the base case.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.3 shots on target. I lean lower: Marseille average 4.7 on target and Le Mans 3.6 (15th), so eight or nine looks more natural. Marseille are efficient rather than high-volume.
